response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    `ANA Pattern`,
    AVG(`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL 
    AND `ANA Pattern` != ''
    AND `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_averages
),
kept_patterns AS (
  SELECT 
    g.`ANA Pattern`,
    g.avg_acl_igg
  FROM group_averages g
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
  WHERE g.avg_acl_igg > o.overall_avg
),
kept_patterns_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_patterns
)
SELECT 
  k.`ANA Pattern` as pattern,
  k.avg_acl_igg as average_acl_igg,
  k.avg_acl_igg - o.overall_avg as above_overall_mean,
  k.avg_acl_igg - km.kept_avg as diff_from_kept_patterns_mean
FROM kept_patterns k
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
CROSS JOIN kept_patterns_mean km

assumptions.assumption: "No recorded pattern" means both NULL and empty string (''). If only NULL should be excluded (treating empty string as a valid recorded value), the WHERE clause in the CTE would change to `WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL`.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude only NULL values from ANA Pattern, treating empty strings as valid recorded patterns
